name: Breaking news bar
summary: Full-width bottom news band: flashing BREAKING block, headline band sliding in and a scrolling ticker under it.

params.name: x
params.note: centre x; keep 540 for a full-width band

params.name: label
params.note: text in the flashing block; keep it short

params.name: headline
params.default: Officials confirm the new plan starts next week

params.name: ticker
params.default: More details to follow  •  Stay with us  •

params.name: color
params.note: label block colour; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

example.label: BREAKING
example.headline: Officials confirm the new plan starts next week

author: krakujs
